name: USDKG
oneLiner: USDKG is Gold Dollar's Kyrgyz-Republic-licensed dollar stablecoin backed by ~376 kg of physical LBMA gold bars custodied via state enterprise Kyrgyzaltyn.
collateral: Physical gold bars (~376 kg, 30 bars) sourced from the Kyrgyz Ministry of Finance via state gold enterprise Kyrgyzaltyn (LBMA Good Delivery listed); stored in sealed boxes at an unnamed bank under custody of LLC Virelint Group
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against USD, Kyrgyzstani som, physical gold, or approved cryptocurrencies through Gold Dollar; KYC/AML verification required for all redemptions

jurisdiction.license: Law on Virtual Assets (2022) / Cabinet Resolution No. 514

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDKG is a USD-pegged, issuer-redeemable stablecoin backed by physical LBMA gold under Kyrgyz Republic oversight; it circulates on Ethereum and TRON and is available to retail and institutional investors globally.

genius.issuerEntity: OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer (state-owned, Ministry of Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic); Gold Dollar operates the issuance; LLC Virelint Group previously cited as operator
genius.licensingRegulator: Ministry of Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic
genius.notes: USDKG is commodity-backed (physical LBMA gold) but USD-referenced and issuer-redeemable; the gold backing raises a question whether it qualifies as a payment stablecoin under GENIUS (which targets fiat-referenced instruments), but no definitive exclusion exists and the USD peg makes apparent-payment-stablecoin the more conservative classification. No public GENIUS approval, PPSI application, or foreign-issuer exception was found. The issuer is a Kyrgyz state-owned entity (OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) with no known U.S. regulatory presence. Listed on Hong Kong's OSL HK exchange (May 2026) — no U.S. regulatory event. No OFAC, FinCEN, or enforcement action found.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, registered foreign-issuer exception, or enforcement action was located for USDKG, Gold Dollar, or OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer. The issuer operates entirely under Kyrgyz Republic licensing with no known U.S. regulatory presence.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDKG has no cross-chain bridge: it is a standalone Tether-style token issued and burned natively on each chain by the issuer (Gold Dollar / OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) via issue()/redeem() functions, with separate, non-identical contract addresses on Ethereum (0xe820...45e3) and Tron (TXZo12...nwEG). Supply on each chain is independently issuer-minted against gold reserves with no cross-chain dependency, so the route is single-chain-or-native rather than opaque.

mintAuthority.summary: USDKG is issued by Gold Dollar under a Kyrgyz Republic virtual-asset license. On Ethereum, the non-upgradeable USDKG token's owner() is a 3-of-7 old-style Gnosis multisig (0xcF355ad32abf378F067fa93a28d96a767FeB7377) with no modules/guards; issue() and redeem() are the mint/burn functions. Tron owner not independently confirmed.

controls.label: Gold Dollar issuance backend
controls.evidence: Gold Dollar operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDKG against custodied physical gold, with KYC/AML required for all redemptions; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: USDKG Ethereum token owner (3-of-7 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295047 (2026-06-11), owner() on USDKG token (0xe820c06321e60d36257c666643fa5436643445e3) returned 0xcF355ad32abf378F067fa93a28d96a767FeB7377. getOwners() on that contract returned 7 owner addresses; threshold()=3. The contract ABI (Blockscout) confirms type=Multisig with getOwners/getThreshold/isOwner but no modules-related functions. No proxy admin or impl slot (non-upgradeable). The USDKG token exposes issue() and redeem() as the mint/burn functions callable by the owner.

review.evidence: Gold Dollar is the sole issuer of USDKG under Kyrgyz virtual-asset regulation; mint/redeem is centralized and KYC/AML-gated against physical gold reserves audited by Kreston Global. On Ethereum (block 25295047): owner()=0xcF355ad32abf378F067fa93a28d96a767FeB7377, confirmed as a 3-of-7 old-style Gnosis multisig (no modules/guards detected). Ethereum token is non-upgradeable (no proxy). Tron deployment (TXZo12qvnEVKvU2zbfuQeMXKusWyxonwEG) owner not independently confirmed due to Tron API format issues.
